app.title: OBS Studio 33
app.author: pentagrama
app.description: OBS Studio is a free, open‑source software for video recording and live streaming, supporting a wide range of formats and plugins.
proposed_tests: Download and install OBS Studio 33 on a test machine; verify the installer completes successfully.
Run `obs --help` from the command line to ensure the CLI interface is available and produces expected usage output.
Launch OBS, create a simple scene, record a 10‑second video clip, and verify that the output file is written and playable.
